verdict.rationale: Unit is API-first infrastructure with a Dashboard described as accessing the same customer/account/payment/card data as the APIs (unit-docs-5), suggesting reasonable UI-API parity, but there is no explicit claim that every dashboard action is API-exposed, and probes show missing OpenAPI spec and machine-readable docs (unit-probe-2, unit-probe-3), undermining verifiability for an AI-native consumer. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, discoverable OpenAPI/API reference, and evidence of AI-agent-friendly API consumption.
